call_purpose: You called because your webinar registration page was not sending the confirmation email and your products page showed the wrong currency.

resolved.text: We turned on the confirmation email for your webinar page and saved it, and after you registered once with another email address, you confirmed the confirmation email arrived.
Following our guidance, you selected Indian Rupee in Settings, Regional, and saved it, and your products page now shows rupees, which you confirmed looks right.
